{{Quote|I've seen some impressive things as a Stormtrooper of the Empire. I've seen Star Destroyers tear apart a battlecruiser with just tractor beams. I've seen command ships so big they take three days to walk from end to end. I even saw Lord Vader once. But I think the greatest thing I ever saw was those squat little dropships, flying out of a binary sunset, loaded with reinforcements, ammunition, medical droids and food.|[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]]|<ref name="TFU2">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Dropship Transport''', or '''IDT''' for short, was a type of craft that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Characteristics==
[[File:TFURaxusPrimeShuttle01.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An Imperial dropship on Raxus Prime]]
Much like the [[Multi-Altitude Assault Transport|MAAT]] gunship<ref name="TFUg" /> and [[Rapid Deployment Airspeeder|RaDAir speeder]],<ref name="TCOC">{{DoD|The Core of Corruption}}</ref> the Imperial dropship transport was similar in design to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> The dropship transport was smaller in size than its Republic predecessor.<ref name="TFUg" />

Its cockpit was elongated in a similar vein to that of the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The internal troop bay was opened by doors on each side that folded up into the ship upon landing. It possessed two large wings, like the LAAT, and two smaller wings on the top.<ref name="TFUg" />

==History==
Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TFUg" /> several Dropship Tranpsorts were used to escape a doomed [[Unidentified Venator-class Star Destroyer (Heinsnake Cult)|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]. They made it to the moon, but the survivors were soon all killed.<ref name="DV9 3">[[Darth Vader and the Ninth Assassin 3|''Darth Vader and the Ninth Assassin'' 3]]</ref>

One such transport was present with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces that occupied the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and deployed a contingent of stormtroopers which came under assault by [[Felucian warrior]]s. The shuttle had landed but the soldiers were killed by [[Galen Marek]] when he came to the world to rescue [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]. Another such shuttle was deployed by the Imperial garrison on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] where it discovered Galen Marek. The stormtroopers present in it attempted to kill the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-user, but were destroyed by the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]].<ref name="TFUg" />

[[File:TFURaxusPrimeShuttle02.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A close up view of the troop bay]]
A dropship transport was later used to deploy stormtroopers on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] when the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Subject 1138|Marek]] attempted to [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escape]]. Several more were constantly used to ferry troops to combat the test subject as he attempted to escape. Afterwards, dropship transports were used at [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] when Starkiller arrived on the planet to free his progenitor's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] mentor, [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]].<ref name="TFU2" /> During the [[Assault on Kamino]], two dropships were used to assault the rebel positions until [[General/Legends|General]] Rahm Kota called Starkiller to aid them. The clone used the Force to send [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] strafing [[Timira City]] crashing into the transports.<ref name="TFU2" />

==Behind the scenes==
These transports did not appear in the PS2, PSP, or Wii version of the ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' video game.
